items.text: A party is starting in the garden. After their snacks, the little animals run behind the trees, into the flowers and through the hedge maze to play hide and seek.

items.text: Little Bear and Little Bunny hold hands. We won't leave anyone behind! Before the storm arrives, cross the maze and the forest, and bring all eight friends home to the little house in the middle.

items.text: All eight friends are safely home! Everyone brings cake, fruit and warm soup. Thank you, Little Bear and Little Bunny! Rain falls outside, but it is warm indoors. Our friends are all together again!
